brief: GS's Industrials & Materials desk sets up the day: Asia equities sold off overnight on a chip-stock rout (Samsung, SK Hynix), with KOSPI down 546bps (as much as 7% intraday), Taiwan -195bps, Japan -182bps; Europe held up better (UK +75bps, France +30bps) as large-bank earnings begin. Crude eased (Brent sub-$105, WTI $92) even as the Russia/Ukraine energy ceasefire collapsed within one news cycle (Trump's deal unconfirmed by Moscow, Russia then struck Ukrainian power infrastructure) and Houthi strikes hit Riyadh airport; the desk calls this a fragile equilibrium because the market is pricing escalation separately from barrels actually lost, with no Hormuz deal reached. 10Y yields fell to 5.19%, dollar softer, NFIB missed. GS's CPI preview: core CPI +0.24%/2.46% yoy (vs 0.2%/2.5% consensus), headline +0.59% (vs 0.6%), consistent with +0.20% core PCE, driven by autos and airfares against benign shelter; October seen +0.2% on shutdown-related seasonal distortions, November/December easing to +0.1%. Micro: Givaudan sales beat, FAST desk-short into earnings on a 16.5% ADS bogey, and a bogey list spanning PCAR, NVT, MMM and JBHT.
